hud_pct_severe_housing_problems.long_name: Households with 1+ of 4 Severe Housing Problems (HUD CHAS)
hud_pct_severe_housing_problems.short_description: Share of occupied housing units with at least 1 of 4 severe housing problems.
hud_pct_severe_housing_problems.long_description: Percentage of occupied housing units (owner + renter) with 1 or more of 4 severe housing problems: lacks complete kitchen facilities, lacks complete plumbing facilities, more than 1.5 persons per room, or cost burden greater than 50%. Computed from HUD's Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS) data, Table 2 (Tenure by Severe Housing Unit Problems by Household Income by Race), as (T2_est3 + T2_est76) / T2_est1 -- the pre-combined owner and renter 'has 1+ severe problems, all incomes, all races' subtotals divided by total occupied units. Released on the ACS 5-year cycle with no fixed schedule. Intended as the direct-source input behind PopHIVE/us-rates' chr_severe_housing_problems measure.
hud_pct_severe_housing_problems.statement: In {location}, {value} of households have a severe housing problem.

hud_chas.name: Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS) data
hud_chas.organization: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
hud_chas.description: CHAS data is a custom tabulation of American Community Survey data produced for HUD, providing detailed cross-tabulations of housing problems (cost burden, overcrowding, and facilities adequacy) by income, tenure, and race, at multiple geographic levels including county. Used here as the direct source for the county-level severe housing problems rate.
hud_chas.restrictions: Public domain. HUD data are generally not subject to copyright restrictions.

_catalog.summary: These data give the share of housing units with at least one of four severe housing problems (incomplete kitchen, incomplete plumbing, more than 1.5 persons per room, or housing cost burden over 50%). This measure is caculated using data from the American Community Survey.
